tradition.name: Afro house angolano
tradition.lineage: Angolan house practice centered in Luanda, connecting programmed house tracks with the local semba/kuduro listening and production environment. Firsthand reporting documents software beatmaking and an Angolan rhythmic identity; the selected model leaves particular traditional acoustic instruments optional.

extras.description: Luanda-centered Angolan Afro house practice. Electronic percussion, repeating bass figures and sampled or recorded hooks support dance tracks shaped by local listening to semba and kuduro. This regional network is distinguished from the catalog’s broader Afro house row; it does not prescribe an amapiano log drum or Lagos studio.

entries.geo_rationale: Luanda is a documented club and beatmaking practice anchor in the 2011 firsthand FADER reporting and Djeff interview; not an exclusive invention claim.

equivalence_check.rationale: No existing id/name match. Existing afro_house is broader and emphasizes different geographic exemplars; kuduro is a neighboring practice, not an established synonym. Regional scope does not justify manufacturing a wholly separate rhythmic system.

tradition.name: Australian house
tradition.lineage: Australian house-production network with a selected bass-driven Melbourne club strand represented by Dom Dolla and Torren Foot, and wider Australian production represented by Sonny Fodera. Contemporary laptop work, programmed drums and repitched vocal hooks are documented artist practices, not a unique national meter.

extras.description: Australian house network, with this recipe selecting the chugging bass, programmed percussion and manipulated hooks documented in Dom Dolla’s productions. Its regional provenance separates the discovery record from umbrella house and tech-house; Australian house encompasses multiple approaches and is not synonymous with Melbourne bounce or lo-fi house.

Secondary roster evidence associates Sum Wave and other library/streaming artists with the label; inspected label credits independently establish Sum Wave’s electronic, melodic, laid-back work. extras.description: A laid-back electronic house discovery label, distinct from the Baltimore band of the same name. This provisional model uses a soft repeating pulse, sustained chord textures and looped samples.
